thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 fired for tenant=BrightHome (reserved pool). Alert: reserved-queue-saturation > 95% for 3m. link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-12345 created and notified oncall (alex).

alex: acked. I'm on it — switching to oncall channel. Any immediate mitigations we can run?

sam: seeing lots of 429s and upstream queue drops from the dedicated pool. p50 ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 2.1s, p99 spiking to 6s. Errors spike at 11:34 UTC.

mira: I can try a quick scale if reserved pool has headroom. If not, we should reroute low-priority traffic to hosted pool to preserve BrightHome SLOs.

alex: confirmed BrightHome reserved GPU pool is at 100% utilization. No autoscale triggered due to reserved capacity limit.

leo: BrightHome support DM'd: some customers seeing timeouts and error 502s at 11:31 UTC. They're asking for ETA.

alex: immediate plan: 1) increase reserved pool by +2 GPUs if infra allows, 2) enable temporary priority throttling for non-critical endpoints, 3) offload traffic for model-variant v2-small to hosted cluster. I'll make the calls.

mira: running scale now:
```bash
# infra CLI
redwoodctl dedicated scale --tenant brighthome --add-gpu 2 --reason "auto-scale P1 PD-12345"
```

mira: command submitted, waiting on quota approval from provisioning.

incident-bot: Provisioning request created (REQ-9876). Estimated completion 4m.

sam: posting recent logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T11:30:58Z] tenant=brighthome req_id=abc123 status=queued queue_len=128 reserved_pool=full
[2026-03-14T11:31:01Z] tenant=brighthome req_id=abc124 status=429 reason=queue_saturation
[2026-03-14T11:31:08Z] tenant=brighthome instance=gpu-12 cpu=92% mem=83% kv_cache_hits=5%
```

alex: thanks. I'm going to temporarily set the routing policy to favor fallback model for any request that matches low-cost predicate. mira, can you also enable throttle for anonymous/test API keys?

mira: doing throttle config:
```json
{
  "rule": "brighthome:throttle:low-prio",
  "match": "api_key in [test_*, anon_*]",
  "rate": "5r/s"
}
```

mira: throttle applied. We'll monitor error rate.

brighthome-support: Confirming customers in EU are reporting ~15% request failures. They're also seeing slower streaming responses. Could we prioritize EU traffic?

alex: noted. We'll add region-pref routing to push EU traffic to unaffected hosted region for the short term.

incident-bot: Provisioning REQ-9876 completed. +2 GPUs added to BrightHome reserved pool (nodes gpu-15,gpu-16).

mira: scale succeeded. New nodes joined and warmed.

sam: post-scale metrics show queue_len dropping from 120 -> 20 over 90s; 429s gone. p99 down to ~400ms.

jess: taking over oncall in 20 minutes — if anything else pops, I'm here. Also I'll run the post-incident verification once we're stable.

alex: thanks team. Logging customer impact: BrightHome experienced 11:30–11:38 UTC elevated errors (peak 15% failures), mainly EU region, caused by reserved pool saturation during unexpected burst. Mitigation: provisioned +2 GPUs, applied temporary throttle for low-priority keys, routed EU traffic to hosted fallback variant.

pagerduty: Incident PD-12345 acknowledged by alex, status: resolved (mitigated).

leo: BrightHome support notified. They asked for a short RCA and action items. I told them we'll follow up with a writeup and a ticket for quota adjustments and autoscale guardrails.

alex: creating follow-up tasks:
- ticket: AUTOSCALE-221: review reserved-pool autoscale triggers and quota failure modes.
- ticket: ROUTING-98: add automatic EU fallback during reserved saturation windows.
- action: contact provisioning to increase BrightHome baseline by +1 GPU for the next 30 days (billing/contract).

jess: quick post-check commands I ran:
```bash
# verify no pending throttles
redwoodctl routing list --tenant brighthome | grep throttle || true
# sanity check model latency
redwoodctl metrics query --tenant brighthome "p95_latency" --since 15m
```

sam: recommending a short runbook update: if reserved_pool==full && provisioning_request_fails -> run immediate offload-to-hosted and notify sales/customer. I'll draft the text.

alex: thanks. I'm closing this thread and will convert notes into the incident tracker entry. Summary to be posted in INCIDENTS channel and linked to PD-12345. Great job everyone :thumbsup:

brighthome-support: Thanks for fast mitigation. We'll await RCA and follow-up.

jess: handing off to next shift, monitoring for 30m then close.

incident-bot: PD-12345 marked resolved at 2026-03-14T11:45:30Z.
